_comment: A rout streaming out through a block that is fighting it (#1757, re-judged for #1949). Blue (team 0): 48 Infantry on 6 files at (780, 760), facing north, put on Hold (Ctrl+H) at tick 12 so it stands its ground rather than chasing. Red (team 1): 16 Infantry at (780, 640), facing south, at morale 1, so it routs on its own at tick 46. Each red man runs on his own for his back edge, to the south, with the blue block between him and it, so he first runs away from blue and then round and through it (SoldierFlightWay). Measured with dense 2-tick FULL dumps on seeds 0 to 4, 2026-11-13 on #1949's branch: the red men's centroid backs off north to about (782, 609) by tick 280, comes on south into the blue block, which is fighting it at tick 400 (pinned: FIGHTING) and IDLE again by tick 600, and runs on to (771.15, 905.22) at tick 600 with all 16 men. Blue holds its facing and its slot grid while the rout goes through: no blue man has his slot across the block's centreline from him at ticks 300 and 400 (slots_across_centreline, pinned; on main fa76accc, before #1757, 25 and 16 did). The FIGHTING pin was at tick 280, when the old flight ran red straight into blue (blue fought it from tick 176 to tick 320); the bottom-up flight (#1949) makes each man run from the enemy he sees before going round it, so red reaches blue later. The state pins tie the slot pins to the story (blue fighting the router at tick 400, the router still routing at 300 and 400).
